comment: The files that the generators of each kind write into its package (make -C packages/fsm-<kind> gen), as globs relative to the package: scripts/gen-check.mts regenerates them into var/gen-check and compares exactly these files with the working tree (docs/plans/fsm-v1.md, C-5). The kinds are the implementations of config/parity.json; each one has its globs.
